description: Facebook 584 — 97 patches with Vietnamese UI, Following feed by default, save photos by default + hide tab bar on the Reels tab (on by default; GĐ4.2: hiding gives the bar's space back instead of leaving a blank strip, and a tap or swipe on the surface brings the bar back for three seconds) + new experimental patch: push the video to the top when comments open (on by default, Hushfacebook settings > Comments); quiet preset.
